items.title: 32.11 Chemical Industries and Pakistan's Economy (chemical industries aur Pakistan ki maeeshat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.11, printed pages 238-239 (PDF 241-242).

blocks.text: Chemical industry Pakistan ki economy (maeeshat) ke liye bohat ahem hai: yeh mulk ki Gross Domestic Product (GDP, mulk mein saal bhar banne wali tamam cheezon aur khidmaat ki qeemat) mein bara hissa dalti hai aur rozgaar deti hai. Yeh doosre bare sectors (shobon) ko support karti hai, jaise agriculture (fertilizers ke zariye), construction (tameerat; cement ke zariye) aur textiles (kapra; dyes aur synthetic fibres ke zariye). Chemical industries mulk mein milne wala (locally available) kaccha maal, jaise natural gas, rock salt, limestone aur crude oil, use kar ke ahem cheezein banati hain, jis se imports (bahar se mangwane) par dependence (inhisar) kam hoti hai.

Pakistan agrarian economy (kheti par chalne wali maeeshat) hai, is liye is ki food security chemical industry par depend karti hai. Local (maqami) companies natural gas se urea banati hain, jis se mulk ka import bill arbon dollar kam hota hai. Pakistan ki exports (bahar bechi jaane wali cheezon) ka 50% se zyada hissa textiles ka hai. Yeh industry bohat bari consumer hai (bohat zyada istemal karti hai): caustic soda (cotton ki mercerizing, yani dhaage ko mazboot aur chamakdar banane ke liye), synthetic dyes (rang aur colour fastness, yani rang pakka rehne ke liye) aur hydrogen peroxide (kapra safed karne, bleaching ke liye). Infrastructure projects (tameerati mansoobon) aur urbanization (shehron ke phailao) ki wajah se cement industry neighboring regions (hamsaya ilaqon) ko cement bechne wali leading exporter ban gayi hai.

blocks.prompt: Mulk mein natural gas se urea banana Pakistan ki economy ki kaise madad karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh agriculture aur food security ko support karta hai aur mulk ka import bill arbon dollar kam karta hai.

items: Chemical industry: GDP aur rozgaar; agriculture, construction aur textiles ko support.
Local urea se import bill kam; textiles 50% se zyada exports (caustic soda, dyes, H₂O₂).
Cement industry neighboring regions ko export karti hai.
